subject: Aurum - SIG kickoff, evidence playbook & scheduling
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurum.com>, security@aurum.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurum - SIG kickoff, evidence playbook & scheduling

Hi Elena / Aurum security team —

Thanks again for engaging with Redwood on the SIG intake. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute kickoff to:
- walk through the questionnaire baseline (CAIQ/SIG overlap),
- confirm owners for each evidence item, and
- review access for sample logs / demo environment.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 9/15 10:00–11:00 AM
- Wed 9/15 2:00–3:00 PM
- Thu 9/16 9:00–10:00 AM

Can you confirm which works and who from your side will join (security, infra, procurement)? If you'd like, we can record the session — please indicate consent.

I've attached a short evidence playbook (draft) and a pre-filled SIG questionnaire to speed the call. We can hand off owners during the meeting and share an action-oriented matrix afterwards.

Attachments: [attachment: evidence_mapping_playbook.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: Aurum_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--

Thanks Sergio — Wed 9/15 10:00 AM PST works for our team.

Attendees from Aurum: me (security lead), Tom Briggs (infra), and I will loop in procurement if we need contract/SLAs later. We do consent to recording the session.

A couple of requests before the call:
1) Can you share a short list of the logs and retention samples you'd like to review? We prefer a simple checklist so we can pull sandbox artifacts ahead of time.
2) We typically send a preliminary CSV of control owners for SIG mapping — is there a template you prefer?

I'll accept the calendar invite once you send it.

Regards,
Elena Park

elena.park@aurum.com

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:01:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Aurum - SIG kickoff, evidence playbook & scheduling (internal prep)

Sergio — great, booking the 9/15 10:00 slot on our side. Internal prep notes below.

Quick checklist to be ready for the call:
- Owner mapping: pre-fill questionnaire with our recommended owners (security, infra, platform ops). Ben can take platform/infrastructure controls; Irene takes data residency / encryption; I’ll own the controls mapping and evidence playbook walk-through.
- Logs: provide one week of sanitized syslog and one week of API access logs (sample). Ben will prepare the syslog package (syslog_sample-202605.tgz).
- CAIQ mapping: we should highlight the 10 highest-effort items (keys, key rotation, egress controls, SIEM integration, backups).
- Procurement ask: if Aurum requests contractual language on data residency, have procurement template ready — Sergio, flag if you expect any negotiation.

Action items (owners / due):
1) Ben: create syslog sample tarball and a short readme describing redaction (due 9/14 EOD).
2) Irene: draft CAIQ mapping cheat sheet for the call (due 9/15 08:00 PST).
3) Marissa: prepare the 'evidence playbook' one-pager and a follow-up action matrix (attach after call).
4) Sergio: send calendar invite with recording consent + prework list to Elena (done).

Calendar invite (internal): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=aurum-sig-9-15

Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@aurum.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@aurum.com>, security@aurum.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Aurum - SIG kickoff, evidence playbook & scheduling

Thanks all — recording consent noted (Elena). Calendar invite is confirmed for Wed 9/15 10:00–11:00 AM PST. Join: https://meet.google.com/aurum-redwood-sig (dial-in in invite).

Attachments for the call (attached to this email and uploaded to the Drive link):
- evidence_mapping_playbook.pdf [attachment]
- Aurum_SIG_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx [attachment]
- syslog_sample-202605.tgz [attachment - internal samples only]

What we'll cover in the 60 minutes:
1) 10m — Introductions & scope (Aurum goals + Redwood coverage)
2) 25m — Walk questionnaire with suggested owners (live edit)
3) 15m — Evidence handoff process + how we accept samples (S3/secure share)
4) 10m — Next steps, deadlines, and points of contact (action matrix)

Elena — per your ask, the pre-call checklist is: syslog sample (sanitized), one example of an API access log, and a short CSV of current control owners (if available). We will not need production credentials — sandbox artifacts are fine.

Post-call deliverable: we'll send a populated action matrix (who/what/due/date) and upload the mapping to the HubSpot link below.

HubSpot Note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765
DocuSign (if/when needed): https://docusign.com/aurum-sig
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyExampleDriveLink

Thanks — see you on the call.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
